properties.title: Sudan: local food prices +50% in 3 months, median of 159 price series (z +2.4)
properties.summary: Median 3-month change to 2026-09 across 159 market-and-commodity series in 19 markets; 94% of series rose. Nominal prices in local currency, judged against the country's own 60 earlier medians.
